hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "function Show-Tree { param($Path = '.', $Indent = '', $Depth = 0, $MaxDepth = 3); if ($Depth -ge $MaxDepth) { return }; Get-ChildItem -Path $Path -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch '^(node_modules|\.next|\.git|bun\.lockb)$' } | ForEach-Object { $isDir = $_.PSIsContainer; $prefix = if ($isDir) { '[D] ' } else { '    ' }; Write-Host \"$Indent$prefix$($_.Name)\"; if ($isDir) { Show-Tree -Path $_.FullName -Indent \"$Indent    \" -Depth ($Depth + 1) -MaxDepth $MaxDepth } } }; Write-Host '=== Project Structure ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Show-Tree -Path $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR -MaxDepth 3"
